msg: The set up of the game involves pairings of gnomes- in my game which I hope are the same as yours they were blue-brown, yellow-red, orange-purple and green-pink. you choose one of those colour pairings of gnomes e.g. picking the brown gnome over the blue one. I was advised to go for yellow toned gnomes which I interpreted as yellow, orange, brown and green. This worked fairly well. However, I realised that sometimes I would inevitably press the incorrect button and not pick one of the yellow toned gnomes, and still receive a large number of mushrooms. So you may attempt to get the yellow toned gnomes, however the key of the game is SPEED. I would press the s or k button almost automatically and then quickly pressed space. Moving quickly was the key otherwise you would miss out on the potential for mushrooms. I missed twice. You can aim for yellow tones but just press a button quickly, basically automatically in order to ensure you are not too slow, because then you can struggle to get your rhythm back.
